normal_return.source: Treasury OTA Technical Paper 5 (Cronin, Lin, Power and Cooper, May 2012), p. 7: "we find that 63 percent of current corporate taxable income is due to supernormal returns" and "the remaining 37 percent of the corporate tax on the taxable income attributable to normal returns"
normal_return.ota_2021_source: Treasury OTA, Treasury's Distribution Methodology and Results (July 2021; Summary-of-OTA-Distribution-Methodology-05102021.pdf), p. 3 note 4: "split between capital income (81.5 percent) and labor income (18.5 percent)"

power_frerick.source: Power and Frerick, Have Excess Returns To Corporations Been Increasing Over Time?, Treasury OTA Working Paper 111 (November 2016; National Tax Journal 69(4), 2016): abstract p. 2, the risk-free share of the C corporation base "averaging 40 percent from 1992-2002 and 25 percent from 2003-2013"; Table 1 p. 16, three-year averages 2011-2013 by industry
power_frerick.rule: cells take their Table 1 industry's share; cells outside its industries take the 2003-2013 average [INFERENCE: the industry map in PF_INDUSTRY]
